device_label: 15.37 mm meandered MZI, 105 nm SrTiO3, 4 K
waveguide_orientation: straight sections at 45, 135 and 225 deg to the in-plane crystal axes; 400 um bend radius
epitaxy_or_stack: 105 nm MBE SrTiO3 (Sr/Ti 0.96 +/- 0.03, in-plane multidomain) bonded onto 2 um SiO2 on Si; PMMA-loaded waveguide, about 43% energy confinement in SrTiO3; 200 um arm unbalance
driver: Keysight 33512B AWG (to 20 MHz, 10 V peak) and B2910BL source-measure unit (to 1 kHz, 40 V peak)
notes: Quasi-static ferroelectric operation: Vpi*L is the author-computed value for the effective Pockels coefficient r_eff 345 +/- 30 pm/V (4 K, remanent zero-field point after poling; r_eff 140 +/- 30 pm/V at 1.6 V/um) and depends on bias history; only the lower MZI arm is modulated (Fig. 3b), 20 Hz, 16 V amplitude over the 10 um gap. A phase shift of pi corresponds to a field change of 0.084 V/um (p.6); VpiL quoted as 1.04 +/- 0.08 V cm; no Vpi in volts is stated and none is derived here. Bandwidth: response flat from about 20 Hz to 1 MHz by an indirect time-averaged power method (response drops below about 20 Hz, attributed to DC screening); setup resonance near 5 MHz; no 3 dB crossing observed, so 1 MHz = 0.001 GHz is a bound and the measurement limit (convention (c)); it is not a measured 3 dB bandwidth and is tagged bw_indirect_method. Electrode type 'lumped' and single-ended drive are inferred from the quasi-static wire-bonded drive and the Fig. 3b caption (authors do not name the electrode type). Waveguide platform 'other' (PMMA-loaded SrTiO3 on SiO2/Si); integration 'other' (MBE on Si, wafer bonded, Si removed). Wavelength 'around 1470 nm' (Supplement 4.1); 1.84 +/- 0.04 group index at 4 K from the FSR (Supplement p.29, formula in paper). Waveguide propagation loss and insertion loss are not given for the cryogenic MZI (extinction ratio limited by asymmetric splitting, no number); room-temperature cut-back loss is in the papers.csv notes.
